school.name: The Newbie School
school.desc: A warm stone hall where old hands teach the ways of the wild. A road leads south.

byway.name: The Midgewater Byway
byway.desc: A rutted road between the school and the crossroads. Reeds crowd the ditches.

crossroads.name: Old Crossroads
crossroads.desc: Four ways meet under a leaning signpost. The forest looms south; a broken tower watches east.

forest_edge.name: Old Forest Edge
forest_edge.desc: Gnarled roots break the path here. Something small and quick skitters in the brush.

watchtower.name: The Watchtower
watchtower.desc: A ruined watchtower on the road. An orc scout keeps its crumbling stairs.

mill_gate.name: Mill Gate
mill_gate.desc: A timber gate opens onto the mill track. The wheel creaks somewhere ahead.

oldmill.name: The Old Mill
oldmill.desc: Dust, flour sacks, and a groaning wheel. Goblins nest in the rafters.
